must_keep.quote: 1.6. Private Aircraft In general, VUMC faculty and staff members are prohibited from using non-commercial (private/corporate/state owned, rented, or borrowed) aircraft (fixed-wing or rotary) for VUMC business travel. Exceptions to this prohibition require written approval in advance of committing to the travel from both the Office of Risk and Insurance Management (https://www.vumc.org/risk-management/management) and the Chief Financial Officer.
